script: their ecosystems have collided, deciding not to comply with each other

props.description: Two luminous orbs — one cool blue (mind), one warm amber (heart) — orbit each other in perfect synchrony, then accelerate toward each other and collide in a burst of scattered light fragments. The fragments slowly drift apart, each following its own erratic spiral outward into a dark void, never reconnecting — leaving the screen split between two diverging trails of light with no shared trajectory.
